questions.question: What motivated you to go on exchange? (pick the most important one) *
questions.answer: Explore new cultures

questions.question: Which aspects were crucial to choosing your study destination? *
questions.answer: I wanted to stay in Europe, in a non-english speaking country

questions.question: How would you rate your overall study abroad experience? *
Additional comments:

questions.answer: Quite difficult

questions.question: What assistance, if any, did you receive when you arrived at your study destination? *
questions.answer: I was in touch with the university - but not a lot. They forgot to send my some very important emails

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the orientation and assistance available to students at your host institution upon arrival? *
Additional comments
questions.answer: It was very difficult to start in january when i did, i think it is easier with the semester start in february

questions.question: How did you find housing? *
questions.answer: I found housing on my own

questions.question: Did you live on campus or off campus? *
questions.answer: Off campus

questions.question: How easy was it to find off campus housing? Any recommendations? *
questions.answer: a bit difficult and very expensive

questions.question: What should future exchange students know about living off campus? *
questions.answer: It is very expensive and there's a lot of annoying fees

questions.question: Overall, how satisfied were you with the housing available to students? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: There should be an opportunity to get a dorm-room in one of the campuses as an exchange student. There should be an agreement about this between the university

questions.question: How easy did you find the registration process at your host institution? *
Additional comments:

questions.answer: I was very confusing a first, but you get to know it after some time

questions.question: What kind of help was available? *
questions.answer: E-mailing with the university

questions.question: How successful were you in registering for the classes you wanted? *
questions.answer: Ok

questions.question: What advice would you offer to future exchange students about registration at your host institution? *
questions.answer: Double check if the courses you want are available at that semester/trimester

questions.question: How satisfied were you with the academic programme at your host institution? *
Additional comments:
questions.answer: The most interesting courses were unfortunately in italian

questions.answer: MA

questions.answer: The level was ok

questions.answer: Some courses were similar some were very different

questions.answer: 1 semester

questions.answer:
Digital cultures and communication research
Consumer Culture
English literature
Anthropology - Globalization and transnationalism

questions.answer: My literature teacher Sara Sullam, DCCR teacher Allesandro Gandini and Consumer culture teacher Massimo Airoldi were all very nice

questions.question: Which non -academic activities would you recommend to future exchange students? Why? *
questions.answer: Walk around the different areas in the city and enjoy an aperitivo and the good food

questions.question: What do you recommend other visiting students see or do on their weekends or holidays? *
questions.answer: Go on trips, it is very easy with train

questions.question: How easy was it to adjust to the local culture of your exchange site? *
questions.answer: Ok easy

questions.question: Do you have any tips for socializing with local students?
What, if any, cultural differences did you find particularly challenging? *
questions.answer: Try to engage and to learn/understand the language

questions.question: What parts of the culture did you most appreciate? *
questions.answer: The supermarkets are really good. And the classics: good food, good aperitivo

questions.question: What are the three most important things you would tell a UCPH student who is going to your host institution on exchange? *
questions.answer: Dontø pancik if you want to switch course once you've started, you can change

questions.question: Is there any other information that you think might prove useful to future exchange students attending your host institution? *
questions.answer: You don't receive the amount of informations you might like - and a lot of it is in italian

questions.question: What was the most rewarding part of your exchange experience? *
questions.answer: New friendships and the opportunity to leave in another country

questions.question: What was the greatest challenge during the exchange? *
questions.answer: They forgot to send me some important emails about my registration once i got here - but i got in touch with some other students who could help

questions.answer: Yes
